mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.material_index_jobs (id, course_id, material_id, operation, revision, file_key, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_until, error_message, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{materialId}, #{operation}, #{revision}, #{fileKey}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{leaseUntil}, #{errorMessage}, #{completedAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW()), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, attempt_count = EXCLUDED.attempt_count, next_attempt_at = EXCLUDED.next_attempt_at, lease_until = EXCLUDED.lease_until, error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message, completed_at = EXCLUDED.completed_at, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.material_index_jobs SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND ((status = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW())) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM edu.material_index_jobs WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW())) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_attempt_at, created_at) LIMIT #{limit}
